title: Difference Between Element Sum and Digit Sum of an Array
summary: Given a positive integer array, calculate the sum of all elements and the sum of all digits appearing in the array.
statement: Given a positive integer array, calculate the sum of all elements and the sum of all digits appearing in the array. Return the absolute difference between these two sums.
constraints: Element sum is the sum of all array values.
Digit sum is the sum of every decimal digit in every value.
Return the absolute difference between those two sums.
reference_solution:
def element_digit_sum_difference(nums):
    return abs(sum(nums)-sum(int(char) for number in nums for char in str(number)))
hints: Use nested iteration over numbers and their decimal characters for the digit sum.
Both accumulations include every required element or digit once, directly matching the two definitions.
editorial: Both accumulations include every required element or digit once, directly matching the two definitions.

Each value is one digit, so the two sums are equal and the result is zero.
